_comment: Flow -> headless scene map for the UI-flow gate (UI_FUNNEL_DECOMPOSITION S8). Each flow runs as `cargo xtask ui-snap <scene> --script scripts/ui-flows/<flow>.json`; the scene builds a fixture (crates/manifold-app/src/ui_snapshot/fixtures.rs) whose tree carries the flow's selectors. Scenes derived from selectors vs fixtures.rs + the fixed rules (select-and-inspect=inspector; scene-setup-*=gltfscene except empty-states=timeline; drag-clip=timeline) and VERIFIED by scripts/run_ui_flows.py: every 'flows' entry PASSes; every 'expected_fail' entry is a known-red flow (mapped to its correct authoring scene, red for a tracked/pending reason, NOT a mapping error — the whole-scene sweep confirmed none pass under any built-in fixture). Validate/regenerate: scripts/run_ui_flows.py.
_path_triggers_comment: Landing flow gate (BUG-313 postmortem): `scripts/run_ui_flows.py --touched <git-range>` diffs the range, matches each touched path against these prefixes, and runs the union of the mapped flow-name filters (same substring semantics as positional filters). A touched scripts/ui-flows/<flow>.json always runs that flow. No prefix match = exit 0, nothing run. Keep prefixes on the UI value-path surfaces flows actually exercise; a new panel/projection file with flow coverage gets a row here in the same commit.
